data.name: Belly Shot
data.description: A gulch gunner can press her firearm directly against a vulnerable location of an adjacent target, dealing additional damage. When the gulch gunner successfully hits an adjacent target with a ranged firearm attack, she deals +%1d6 points of damage. Creatures immune to precision damage, critical hits, or sneak attacks do not take this additional damage.|1+(GunslingerLVL-9)/4
